style: Playful premium illustrated Chinese city poker game background, warm hand-painted miniature diorama, cinematic dusk lighting, subtle paper texture, elegant jade and amber palette. Wide 16:9 landscape. Landmark silhouettes around upper corners and edges; calm dark center reserved for a large poker table UI. No cards, no interface, no people, no lettering, no logos, no watermark.
nanjing: Nanjing inspired city scene: lantern-lit Qinhuai riverside architecture, Ming-style city wall, distant purple mountain silhouette, warm gold lights reflected in jade water.
lianyungang: Lianyungang inspired coastal scene: harbor cranes and small sailboats near the edges, misty mountain silhouette inspired by Huaguo Mountain, turquoise waves and distant island, whimsical soft sea breeze.
wuhan: Wuhan inspired riverside scene: Yellow Crane Tower silhouette in one upper corner, broad Yangtze river, illuminated bridge far in the distance, amber and plum evening sky.
yancheng: Yancheng inspired wetland scene: graceful red-crowned cranes near reeds at the edges, a distant deer silhouette, broad calm marsh water, sage green and soft golden dusk.
tianjin: Tianjin inspired Haihe river scene: a softly illuminated observation wheel in an upper corner, varied riverside building silhouettes, a delicate bridge, elegant dusty rose and teal twilight.
